specs.Other Special Features of the Product: 10000mAh Type C Input Power Bank, 12W USB-A Output, BIS Certified, LED Battery Indicator, Type C Input Port

features: 10,000 mAh Power Bank: Portronics Luxcell B12 is a fast & efficient power bank with a max output of 12 watts. Charge your devices multiple times with this 10,000 mAh battery high-capacity power bank.
USB-A Output Port: Fast charge your devices using the 12-watt USB-A output port on the power bank. Compatible with smartphones, speakers, neckbands, earbuds, smartwatches, etc.

Type C Input Port: Comes with a Type-C port that supports charging the power bank. Connect the Type C port located on the Power Bank to a USB charger using the charging cable provided & use it to charge the powerbank directly.
Advanced Design Excellence: Proudly made in India, this power bank combines fast charging, lasting performance, and sleek design. It comes with a complimentary charging cable for added convenience.
LED Battery Indicator: The LED indicator keeps you updated on the available charge in this 10000mAh fast-charging power bank. It also includes a Wake-Up button to easily activate the battery bank.
BIS-Certified: With advanced chip protection layers, this durable power bank offers superior protection to your devices against short circuits, high temperatures, and over-voltage issues.
Compact and Lightweight: Luxcell B12's slim and durable body makes it a travel essential. It easily fits in your pocket or bag, so you stay powered up wherever you are - be it work, travel, or home.
Affordable Power Solution: Budget-friendly and essential, this power bank is cost-effective, catering to your charging needs, especially on the go.
